# `browser-tab history`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab history [FLAGS]`

Query the browser's global URL history (Chrome-family; Safari opt-in)

## Flags

### `--browser <name>`

Limit to one browser (omit to merge all reachable sources)

### `--query <text>`

Case-insensitive substring filter on URL/title

### `--start <ms>`

Only visits at/after this epoch ms

### `--end <ms>`

Only visits at/before this epoch ms

### `--limit <n>`

Max rows
